verdict.rationale: QuickBooks offers rule-based automations (bank feed matching, reconciliation, payment reminders, invoice automation) and an AI chat assistant (Intuit Intelligence) that can trigger actions on request, plus an MCP server exposing 145 tools for programmatic/agentic access. However, these are largely triggered or supervised actions rather than persistent, autonomous background agents that run independently without user prompting. missing for 10: evidence of a true autonomous scheduler/agent framework that runs multi-step workflows unattended, independent verification of the AI features actually operating unsupervised, and clarity on how the MCP server enables background automation versus on-demand tool calls.
